facts.value: The Industrials sector comprises firms and companies operating in manufacturing capital goods and machinery that are used for producing other goods. The main objective of this sector is to produce goods, resources, and services that are indirectly beneficial to the end customer.

metadata.chunk_title: Industrial Sector Definition

facts.value: The main types of industrials sector include automotive, aerospace, chemical, construction, and others.

metadata.chunk_title: Industrial Sector Definition

facts.value: The products are sold directly to large firms instead of retail consumers.

metadata.chunk_title: Industrial Sector Definition

facts.value: Even though this sector is volatile to the economic cycles, the firms involved make huge profits.

metadata.chunk_title: Industrial Sector Definition

facts.value: It is also strongly affected by market forces.

metadata.chunk_title: Industrial Sector Definition

facts.value: The manufacturing sector is the focus of the industrial group.

metadata.chunk_title: Industrial Sector Definition

facts.value: However, the materials sector also engages in the manufacture, albeit of raw materials.
